intuition: The longest complete prefix is the first index beyond a contiguous run of uploaded videos.

brute_force.approach: After every upload, rescan from video 1 until the first missing video.

optimal.approach: Track uploaded IDs in a Boolean array and advance one pointer whenever its next video becomes available.

edge_cases: Uploading a video past a gap does not advance the prefix.
The pointer may advance across several already-uploaded videos at once.
